title: Zesty Dense Australian Squid Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Australian dish featuring squid, this recipe is high in protein and perfect for a weeknight dinner. The fermentation process adds a unique flavor to the dish.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together vegetable oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and honey.
Add the squid pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated squid onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the squid is cooked through.
While the squid is cooking, mix the chopped kimchi into the remaining marinade.
Brush the kimchi marinade onto the squid during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional kimchi if desired.
